known_issues.title: Intermittent camera fallback to synthetic source
UDP incomplete-frame loss during startup bursts
Transcript fidelity and phrase segmentation tuning
Thread monitor implemented but not integrated into active runtime
known_issues.progress: `pc/services/thread_monitor.py` defines `ThreadMonitor`, but no runtime imports or call paths instantiate it.

known_issues.title: Unused duplicate bottom-panel builder in OperatorConsoleApp
known_issues.progress: `OperatorConsoleApp._build_bottom_panel()` is not called and duplicates `self.log_box` construction already performed in `_build_logs_tab()`.

known_issues.title: Ambiguous video heartbeat and chunk packet classification
known_issues.progress: `UDPVideoReceiver._handle_packet()` treats `packet[0]` as a packet type while chunk payloads are `CHUNK_HEADER(!IHH)` without a packet-type field.

known_issues.title: Pi streamer SSH command construction assumes shell-safe paths
known_issues.progress: `PiStreamerManager` interpolates unquoted path strings into remote shell in `query_status()` and stop branch of `run_action()`.

known_issues.title: Video receiver binds UDP socket during widget construction
known_issues.progress: `UDPVideoReceiver.__init__()` binds `self._socket` before `start()`, and `OperatorConsoleApp.connect()` constructs the widget inside the connection sequence.

known_issues.title: First-use Whisper model loading delays worker readiness
known_issues.progress: `WhisperService._get_model()` performs `whisper.load_model("base")` on first transcription call inside the worker thread.

known_issues.title: Audio resampling ratio is hard-coded instead of configuration-derived
known_issues.progress: `AudioReceiverService.run()` uses `resample_poly(..., up=1, down=3)` while runtime settings expose configurable `pi_sample_rate` and `whisper_sample_rate`.

known_issues.title: Misspelled UDPVideoReciever compatibility alias remains exposed
known_issues.progress: `pc/video/receiver_widget.py` and archived compatibility shims export `UDPVideoReciever` for backward compatibility.
